💻 **Looking for a job platform account**

I need someone who can provide a job platform account so I can work remotely.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📌 **Requirements**
• PC / laptop for remote work
• Over 24 years old

💰 **Benefit**
• I will share **10%–40%** of income __(negotiable, depends on location)__
• If I don't make any money that month, I will pay **$100**

⚠️ **No upfront payment**
Please don't ask me to pay upfront.
I will only pay $100 right after the trial period — **one month**.
